name: Agent Control Standard
description: Sends each agent step, signed, to an ACS Guardian and enforces its decision.

keyId.description: The key_id the Guardian knows the shared key by.

keyFile.description: A file whose bytes are the shared key.

keyEnv.description: An environment variable whose value is the shared key.

hkdf.description: How the Guardian derives each session's HMAC key from the shared key.

deadlineMs.description: The longest one hook waits for the Guardian, every step it sends and its handshakes included. Shorter than hookTimeoutMs.

hookTimeoutMs.description: The timeout the plugin asks OpenClaw to give each of its hooks. Longer than deadlineMs, so the plugin answers before OpenClaw gives up on the hook; OpenClaw's message_sending sends the original message on a timeout.

maxUndecidedMessages.description: The most messages of one session the plugin keeps for a run not yet admitted. A message beyond it is dropped with blockedReplyText.
